summary: First test run of Dutch Douchebeslag inventory app (Expo + FastAPI). Backend: 32/32 pytest tests PASS covering auth, role gates (monteur/magazijn/admin), articles CRUD, duplicate article_number+barcode (409), by-barcode known/unknown, PATCH immutability of article_number, barcode linking admin-only + duplicate rejection, mutations (afboeken over-stock -> 409 with stock unchanged, idempotency via client_request_id, correctie sets stock+delta, 10-way concurrency never goes negative - exactly 5x201 + 5x409), dashboard & users CRUD, deactivated user cannot login. Frontend (390x844 mobile): admin login + dashboard metrics (26 actieve / 5 onder minimum / 34 mutaties-24u) rendering; dashboard search Enter navigates to /artikelen?q=glasklem with 4 results; below-min metric filters list; article detail shows Fysiek/Gereserveerd/Beschikbaar; MutationSheet admin shows all 4 types, booking retour +2 updates stock, large afboeken shows duidelijke foutmelding ("Onvoldoende voorraad: er zijn 12 stuks op voorraad"); artikel-form creates TEST artikel with initial_stock -> ontvangst mutation shown in historie; edit view hides article_number as editable input (shown as read-only text + help). Scannen tab manual input: unknown barcode shows Onbekende-barcode-paneel + admin ziet 'Koppel aan bestaand artikel' knop -> koppel screen -> link-article-DB-1003 + link-confirm-button -> toast 'Barcode gekoppeld aan DB-1003' + nieuwe barcode zichtbaar; known barcode (8712345000011/028) navigeert naar artikeldetail. Monteur login: geen Nieuw-knop op /artikelen, geen Bewerken op detail, MutationSheet toont uitsluitend Afboeken+Retour (ontvangst/correctie verborgen), geen koppel-knop op onbekende barcode. Admin gebruikersbeheer screen opent met users + active-switches. All deprecated-expo-package checks: none found. No React Native red screen, no console errors. Overall: 32/32 backend + 100% requested frontend flows pass.
action_items: No fixes required. All PRD-level flows (auth, RBAC, articles, barcodes, mutations incl. concurrency+idempotency, dashboard, scan + koppel, users) verified end-to-end on backend and mobile UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 234: bare `except Exception` is caught in auth; acceptable but masks pymongo InvalidId; consider narrowing to (InvalidTokenError, bson.errors.InvalidId, KeyError).
PATCH /api/articles accepts extra fields like article_number without 422 (silently ignored because Pydantic model excludes it) - works but could be hardened with ConfigDict(extra='forbid').
Backend uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup' / 'shutdown') - FastAPI recommends lifespan context managers. Not breaking but worth migrating.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST-prefixed articles via API (TEST-CA-*, TEST-LB-*, TEST-AF-*, TEST-ID-*, TEST-CO-*, TEST-CN-*) and one TEST-UI-* via frontend form. One TEST monteur user (test_*@test.local) created+deactivated via API. Seed demo data (20 articles DB-1001..DB-6003) untouched except: DB-1001 physical_stock was adjusted via UI mutation sheet (admin booked retour +2, so DB-1001 is now 38 instead of 40; also afboeken 3 during monteur earlier). DB-1003 now has an extra TESTBC... barcode linked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py are idempotent (each test creates its own TEST- article). Frontend testIDs verified: form-article-number-input / form-description-input / form-category-input / form-min-stock-input / form-initial-stock-input / form-save-button for artikel-form; mutation-type-{afboeken|ontvangst|retour|correctie}, mutation-qty-input, mutation-submit-button, mutation-error for MutationSheet; scan-manual-input, scan-manual-submit, scan-unknown-title, scan-link-barcode-button for Scannen; link-article-{article_number}, link-confirm-button for Koppel. Dashboard search submits only on Enter (onSubmitEditing), not on each keystroke.
